items.title: Axita Cotton submits EoI to acquire Varidhi Cotspin through insolvency process

items.title: Air India Express pilots raise concerns over income certainty, leave cuts despite revised pay package
items.description: The revised package includes increased monthly earnings across pilot ranks, a Boeing 737 fleet allowance of up to Rs 21 lakh for Senior Commanders and Commanders, and Rs 10 lakh for Senior First Officers, to be paid in three equal instalments over three years from October 2026.

items.title: Pilots’ body seeks mandatory fatigue system from DGCA after Batik Air incident
items.description: The pilots’ federation has urged the aviation regulator to strengthen fatigue safeguards and move beyond duty-time limits after a serious cockpit sleep incident involving Batik Air pilots

items.title: Farm labour shortage drives tractor demand as weak monsoon fails to dent sales
items.description: Farm workers moving to cities and alternative jobs are accelerating mechanisation across the hinterland, helping tractor sales remain strong despite weather-related pressures
